Kerneon’s first open-source technical preview is built for people who want to understand performance before changing it.

### What is ready to test

- Native Windows resource, process, event and frame-delivery monitoring
- Surge bottleneck routing, reversible session controls and measured proof windows
- Capability-gated NVIDIA/AMD GPU tuning laboratory with explicit risk consent
- Responsive LAN Remote Link, QR pairing and local screen/input grants
- Hardware Passport, Event Lens, Frame HUD and opt-in AI insights

### Read before installing

This is an **unsigned technical preview**, not a production release. Windows may show an unknown-publisher warning. Verify the download using `SHA256SUMS.txt`, keep experimental tuning off on irreplaceable systems, and use Remote Link only on a trusted private network.

No improvement is guaranteed. An observed clock increase is not presented as an FPS gain unless repeated comparable frame windows earn that result.
